profile.name: Liu Liu
profile.title: Embodied AI & World Models Lead
profile.title_zh: 具身智能・世界模型方向负责人
profile.bio: Research and technical lead with end-to-end experience spanning foundational 3D perception, scalable data systems, and embodied AI. I focus on world action models, interactive 3D world generation, and 3D reconstruction and understanding, with an emphasis on turning research into deployed systems and open-source ecosystems.
profile.bio_zh: 具备从底层3D感知、规模化数据系统到具身智能算法的完整研发经历，长期聚焦世界动作模型、可交互3D世界生成、3D重建及理解，并推动研究成果走向系统落地与开放生态。关注具身智能方向的技术和合作交流。

research_focus.title: Unified World Action Models
research_focus.description: Building a scalable multimodal data pyramid and automated annotation across internet, ego, and robot data, while advancing multiple technical tracks in parallel.
research_focus.description_zh: 打通多模态数据金字塔的规模化拓展与自动化标注，覆盖互联网数据、Ego数据与Robot数据，推动多条技术方案主线并行推进。

research_focus.title: 3D Generation & Interactive Environments
research_focus.description: Leading simulation-ready 3D world generation, in-place scene completion, and controllable digital twins for embodied training and evaluation.
research_focus.description_zh: 主导可交互3D世界生成、原位场景补全与可控数字孪生，为具身策略训练、评测和轨迹合成提供仿真就绪环境。

research_focus.title: 3D Reconstruction & Understanding
research_focus.description: Developing feed-forward 3D foundation models, streaming geometry-instance understanding, and persistent 3D spatial memory for embodied agents.
research_focus.description_zh: 推进Feed-Forward 3D基础模型、流式几何-实例理解与持久化3D空间记忆，服务具身Agent的感知与执行闭环。

experience.role_zh: 具身智能・世界模型方向负责人
experience.summary: Responsible for technical roadmaps and system delivery across unified world action models, 3D generation and interactive environments, and 3D reconstruction and understanding.
experience.summary_zh: 负责统一世界动作模型、3D生成及可交互环境、3D重建及理解三条方向的技术路线与系统落地。
highlights: Unified World Action Models: scale the multimodal data pyramid and automate annotation across internet, ego, and robot data, advancing multiple technical approaches in parallel.

3D Generation & Interactive Environments: lead EmbodiedGen / V2 and serve as Project Lead for 3D-Fixer and ManiSplat, connecting simulation-ready scene generation with completion, digital twins, and manipulation trajectories.

3D Reconstruction & Understanding: drive HoloAgent-0 and its persistent 3D spatial memory as a corresponding author; lead IGGT4D's streaming 4D understanding and 147K-sequence data system, and Uni3R's unified reconstruction and semantic understanding.
highlights_zh: Unified World Action Model：打通多模态数据金字塔的规模化拓展与自动化标注（互联网数据、Ego数据、Robot数据），推动多条技术方案主线并行推进。
3D生成及可交互环境：主导 EmbodiedGen / V2；作为 Project Lead 推动 3D-Fixer 原位场景补全与 ManiSplat 可控数字孪生及操作轨迹合成。
3D重建及理解：推动 HoloAgent-0 统一Agent框架与持久化3D空间记忆落地并担任通讯作者；作为 Project Lead 负责 IGGT4D 的流式4D理解与14.7万序列数据体系，以及 Uni3R 的统一3D重建与语义理解。

experience.role: Autonomous Driving 4D Label & Closed-loop Simulation Technical Lead
experience.role_zh: 自动驾驶 4D Label&闭环仿真技术负责人
experience.summary: Led a production-grade vision-only 4D labeling system and Horizon's first 3D Gaussian Splatting closed-loop simulation and data synthesis pipeline.
experience.summary_zh: 带队交付国内首套纯视觉4D Label标注系统，并主导地平线首个基于3D Gaussian Splatting的闭环仿真与数据合成系统。

experience.company_zh: 深圳奥比中光科技有限公司
experience.role_zh: 3D感知算法负责人 / 算法工程师
experience.summary: Led product development across monocular and stereo depth, LiDAR-camera fusion and calibration, ToF, and single-photon LiDAR systems.
experience.summary_zh: 负责单目/双目深度、LiDAR-Camera融合与标定、ToF及单光子LiDAR等产品的算法研发与工程落地。

service.label: Professional appointment
service.content: Committee Member, Technical Committee on 3D Vision, China Society of Image and Graphics (CSIG).
service.content_zh: 中国图象图形学学会（CSIG）三维视觉专业委员会委员。

service.label: Patents
service.content: More than 10 domestic and international 3D vision patents, covering depth estimation, stereo matching, LiDAR-camera calibration, sensor synchronization, single-photon LiDAR ranging, and point cloud processing.
service.content_zh: 国内外3D视觉相关专利10余项，覆盖深度估计、立体匹配、LiDAR-Camera标定、传感器同步、单光子LiDAR测距与点云处理等。

service.label: Book contribution
service.content: Contributed to 《智能驾驶与多维重建》 (China Machine Press, 2025), covering 3D reconstruction, 4D labeling, mapping and localization, simulation, and visualization through industry practice.
service.content_zh: 参与编撰《智能驾驶与多维重建》（机械工业出版社，2025），结合产业实践介绍三维重建、4D标注、建图定位、仿真与可视化。

service.label: Peer review
service.content: Reviewer for conferences including CVPR, NeurIPS, AAAI, and IROS, as well as journals.
service.content_zh: 担任 CVPR、NeurIPS、AAAI、IROS 等会议及期刊审稿人。

open_source.title: HoloAgent-0
open_source.description: A unified, agentic system for general-purpose robots, enabling multi-modal perception, mapping and localization, and autonomous mobility and manipulation. v0 release.
open_source.description_zh: 面向通用机器人的统一Agent系统，融合多模态感知、建图定位、自主移动与操作，并通过持久化3D空间记忆构建可反馈的执行闭环。

open_source.title: EmbodiedGen V2
open_source.description: A generative 3D world engine for embodied intelligence — V2 upgrade with enhanced generation quality and expanded capabilities. Project page, paper, and open-source code available.
open_source.description_zh: 面向具身智能的生成式3D世界引擎；V2进一步提升生成质量、物理与尺度一致性，并扩展仿真就绪能力。

news.content: DreamWAM and Faster-WAM released, advancing robust and efficient world action models.
news.content_zh: DreamWAM 与 Faster-WAM 发布，推进更鲁棒、更高效的世界动作模型。
HoloAgent-0 与 EmbodiedGen V2 发布。

news.content: SimWeaver and IGGT4D project pages and paper released.
news.content_zh: SimWeaver 与 IGGT4D 项目主页及论文发布。

news.content: NoDrift3R and TabletopGen accepted to ECCV 2026.
news.content_zh: NoDrift3R 与 TabletopGen 被 ECCV 2026 接收。

news.content: Three papers accepted to CVPR 2026: Uni3R (highlight), 3D-Fixer, and RoboTransfer.
news.content_zh: 三篇论文被 CVPR 2026 接收：Uni3R（Highlight）、3D-Fixer 与 RoboTransfer。
IGFuse 被 AAAI 2026 Oral 接收。

news.content: EmbodiedGen and RoboTransfer project pages and repositories went live in the Robot Lab ecosystem.
news.content_zh: EmbodiedGen 与 RoboTransfer 项目主页和代码仓库在 Robot Lab 生态中上线。
